blurb: Guests fish for Pacific salmon species, Lingcod, Pacific Cod, Rockfish, Prawns, and Crab in the Comox Valley and central Salish Sea. Charters operate year-round with full and half-day options, focusing on protected waters close to shore. The fleet features modern boats with heated cabins, private washrooms, and spacious fishing areas.
